friendly_name: One owner for DocKitty's internal process.env handoffs
purpose_context: DocKitty passes five values between its Astro hooks through process.env. Each was added on its own, and one (the resolved draft-publication setting) is never cleared, so a second config or test in the same process inherits it. One module will own the names and their lifecycle, with no change to site output.
purpose_tldr: Put the values DocKitty passes between its own build hooks under one owner, so none can leak from one site config into the next.
